rule_text.name: 702.237a
rule_text.rule: Eureka! is a triggered ability of some permanents. “Eureka!” means “At the beginning of each end step, you get a research counter if you cast a spell this turn. Then if you have eight or more research couters, you lose all research counters, then create your choice of Cultivating Spheres, Mirror of Possibilities, and Thrice-Folded Lotus.”

rule_text.name: 702.237b
rule_text.rule: Cultivating Spheres is a colorless Masterpiece artifact token with “At the beginning of your draw step, draw an additional card” and “You may play an additional land on each of your turns.”

rule_text.name: 702.237c
rule_text.rule: Mirror of Possibilities is a colorless Masterpiece artifact token with “Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {3}. If you do, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy”

rule_text.name: 702.237d
rule_text.rule: Thrice-Folded Lotus is a colorless Masterpiece artifact token with “{T}: Add three mana of any one color” and “{3}, {T}: Thrice-Folded Lotus deals 3 damage to any target.”

rule_text.name: 702.237e
rule_text.rule: Eureka! checks if you cast a spell this turn when the ability resolves. This means you can cast a spell in response to the trigger to get a counter.

notes: Closed ordinary token definitions from702.237b-d, not sideboard selection.
Full original source programs retained; independent Archive/Discovery companion semantics require owning packages.
